title: Time Jump: 11:40 — Caterer Decision Logged, 35 Cases, Noon Deadlines

fields.scenarioTitle: Side Dish — Supper Outbreak, Line List & One Count
fields.narration: EXERCISE MATERIAL. It is now 11:40 on Monday, October 12, 2026. One hour has passed since Prairie Table's owner called. The decision on Prairie Table Catering has been made and logged. Whatever you decided now governs the caterer's 18:00 prep for Tuesday's 11:30 senior meal. The leftover coleslaw, the pasta salad and the bag of raw chicken thighs are still in Prairie Table's walk-in. They have to be collected under chain of custody. As of 11:30 the coded line list holds 35 cases, and new calls keep coming in. All six outbreak hotline lines have been busy for more than two hours. In twenty minutes, at 12:00, the MRMC Facebook post saying '14 patients' goes live. At 13:00 the superintendent sends his letter to every district family. It blames 'bad coleslaw,' and MCHD has not approved it. The Prairie Valley 7 interview with the Director is at 15:30. And two mutual aid nurses, one from Garrison County and one from Pell County, have just called the front desk. They are in the parking lot of the Marlow County Services Building and want to know where to report and what to do.
worldState: Clock is 11:40, Monday, October 12, 2026. Compressed time is in effect for the rest of the exercise.

The Prairie Table decision is logged and cannot be reopened. The Director states what it is and who is collecting the leftover coleslaw, the pasta salad and the raw chicken thighs (Kessler items on invoice KPV-10-0931) with custody forms.
Prairie Table's crew is still due in at 18:00 to prep about 85 boxed lunches for Tuesday's 11:30 senior meal, unless the logged decision changes that.
The coded line list holds 35 cases as of 11:30, HD26-001 to HD26-035, with no names. A tier breakdown for 11:30 has not been run yet.
HD26-009 is still admitted at MRMC. HD26-003 is GI PCR positive for Salmonella. Culture confirmation and the isolate are still pending. The blood culture ID for HD26-009 is still pending.
Outbreak hotline 555-0150: all six lines have been busy since 09:15, and callers are still waiting.
12:00: the MRMC Facebook post ('14 patients ... community event') goes live unless the hospital hears otherwise.
13:00: the district parent letter ('dozens of students sickened by bad coleslaw') goes out unless MCHD objects. It is in English only.
14:00: the Fenwick Ledger deadline. 15:30: the Prairie Valley 7 on-camera interview with the Director at the County Services Building.
Two mutual aid nurses, from Garrison and Pell, are waiting in the parking lot. They have no assignment, no building access and no copy of the hotline script.
fields.facilitatorNote: Hold the players to three things before they move on: the Director restates the caterer decision and names who collects the samples, the PIO lists every product due by 12:00 and 13:00 and who approves each one, and the Epi Lead commits to a tier and an as-of time on the next count. Do not reveal the timeline yet. The MRMC stool culture for HD26-003 grows Salmonella at 15:20, and the line list reaches about 90 coded cases by Monday evening. If players stall on the nurses, prompt with the hotline script and the call note form.

instructorNote: This card resets the room after the caterer decision and stacks several deadlines at once: the 12:00 hospital post, the 13:00 school letter and the 15:30 interview. Watch whether the Director restates the Prairie Table decision and names who collects the samples, whether the PIO lists the products due by 12:00 and 13:00 with their approvers, and whether the Epi Lead commits to a count with a tier and an as-of time rather than just quoting '35'.
